prediction_unit: One Sparkov simulated card transaction evaluated against its source is_fraud label.

cross_partition.finding: Source train/test order is chronological by observed event time; customer-like continuity spans the boundary.

proposed_partition_protocol.ordering: Sort only by parsed trans_date_trans_time ascending, with trans_num as an audit/deduplication reference rather than a feature.
proposed_partition_protocol.base_model_fit: An early chronological prefix of source_train, with an explicit cutpoint selected and recorded before fitting.
proposed_partition_protocol.calibration_selection: A later, disjoint chronological segment of source_train. It must not be used for base-model fitting.
proposed_partition_protocol.final_test: The untouched source_test partition, after checksum verification and a run-time assertion that its minimum event time exceeds source_train maximum event time.
proposed_partition_protocol.cutpoint_rule: No numeric cutpoint or minimum-positive-label rule is accepted yet. The reviewer must approve them before any approved-data run.

required_leakage_controls: Exclude is_fraud from all model inputs.
Exclude unnamed CSV index, cc_num, personal names, address/location, date of birth, job, and all raw source identifiers from model inputs.
Forbid random row splitting and all preprocessing/statistics fitted across calibration or final-test partitions.
Forbid any feature whose source availability is after decision time; label availability remains unknown and labels are evaluation-only.

Treat the 908 cross-boundary customer-like references as historical continuity, not a licence to use card references. Any future entity-history feature needs an approved keyed pseudonymisation and point-in-time state calculation.
Assert no event-reference overlap across fit, calibration, and final-test partitions.
Fit category encoders, imputers, scalers, and resampling only on the base-model-fit partition.
required_reports: PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, Brier score, and reliability/calibration evidence.
Threshold sweep with precision, recall, false-positive rate, review-rate, and explicit non-authoritative cost assumptions.
Partition dates, label prevalence, feature schema hash, data checksums, code/config revision, and random seed.
Limitations: simulated mechanics, unknown label maturity, incomplete Plaid parity, and no production-performance claim.
decision_recommendation: Use this only as a proposed protocol for mechanics-only evaluation. An authorised reviewer must accept target, cutpoints, label treatment, feature set, and release criteria before Notebook 08 approved-data mode.
